m1_banner.title: Raise the banner
m1_banner.text: A hall and a flag do not make a kingdom. Give your people bread and trade: build a Farm and a Market.

m2_ruins.title: Whispers in the stones
m2_ruins.text: Old songs say the Nine Crowns were forged from one. The ruins near the capital remember. Go and listen.

m3_cave.title: The shard in the crystal
m3_cave.text: The stones spoke of a shard of the first crown, carried into the Crystal cave by kobolds who love anything that shines. Delve in and take it back.

m4_camp.title: Safe roads
m4_camp.text: Bandits bleed the roads your caravans need. Break one of their camps for good.

m5_town.title: From settlement to town
m5_town.text: The other kingdoms will only take you seriously behind stone walls. Raise your capital to the age of the Town.

m6_crypt.title: The second shard
m6_crypt.text: A second shard lies with the Crypt lord, a king who refused to stay dead. Find the Old crypt and end him.

m7_fort.title: The drowned crown
m7_fort.text: Both shards hum when they point west, toward the sea. The last piece sits on the head of a troll king in the Sunken fort.

m8_city.title: A crown worth wearing
m8_city.text: The crown is whole again, but a crown is only a symbol. Make your capital a City, and let the other kingdoms see what you built.

s_hogs.title: Hogs in the barley
s_hogs.text: Wild hogs are tearing up the fields. Drive off two herds.

s_wolves.title: Wolf winter
s_wolves.text: Wolves take a sheep a night. Hunt two packs.

s_supplies.title: Stone for the walls
s_supplies.text: The masons will pay well for a big order of stone and timber.

s_explore.title: Mapmaker
s_explore.text: A scholar wants the land charted. Discover eight places.

s_bakers.title: Fresh bread
s_bakers.text: Every town worth the name smells of bread. Build a Bakery and a Mill.

s_crew.title: A proper war band
s_crew.text: Fill your band: the Champion and four soldiers.

s_iron_road.title: Iron road
s_iron_road.text: Smiths need iron. Stockpile 20 iron in the capital.

s_people.title: Growing pains
s_people.text: Houses and food bring families. Reach 16 people.
